evidence.quote: Standard-plan customers may request a refund within 14 calendar days of delivery.
Before approving a request, record the plan, order channel, delivery date, product type, requested remedy, and any applicable contract or regional scope.

answer_parts.text: For Standard-plan customers on direct-sale physical goods, the return window is within 14 calendar days of delivery. The required fields to record a case are: plan, order channel, delivery date, product type, requested remedy, and any applicable contract or regional scope.
